description: Send ONE TEST of a Mailchimp campaign draft to up to 5 addresses the user names (never to the audience), so they can see it in a real inbox. Without confirm:true nothing is sent and you get the preview; call again with confirm:true after they say yes. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: send_mailchimp_test_email
title: Send a Mailchimp test email
